text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Grummmbbllle... gurgle gurgle...*)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: So it would seem...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Very well, let us stop for tea before 
heading back. 
I shall settle the bill. Go ahead and find 
a place.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Somewhere we can enjoy a light bite. 
I leave it to you, Brian.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: I believe I said a light bite.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. They've got half-ramen and 
half-fried rice. 
You can keep it light if you want.

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Order up! 
One large chashu ramen, comin' right up!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph. Time to dig in. 
Looking forward to the free noodle refill, 
too.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(............*Sigh*... 
I have only myself to blame for leaving it 
to Brian...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Upon arriving at the ramen shop, 
I spotted Phalaenopsis wearing an utterly 
bewildered expression, 
and Narita Brian looking thoroughly 
satisfied.
choice_data_list: Oh? Did you two come to have ramen, too?
Oh? Are you two here to eat ramen as well?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer. ...Hardly. 
We had intended to have a "light bite." 
Right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Phalaenopsis explained what happened. 
Calling ramen a "light bite" was certainly 
quite a stretch...
choice_data_list: Why not just get a half-portion, then?

You're already here, so why not indulge 
for once?

You're already here, so you might as well 
treat yourself for once!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Phalaenopsis explained what happened. 
Calling ramen a "light bite" was certainly 
quite a stretch...
choice_data_list: Why not just get a half-portion, then?

You're already here, so why not indulge 
for once?

You're already here, so you might as well 
treat yourself for once!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, I was thinking along the same 
lines.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
—No, wait. 
In that case, order a full bowl of karaage 
ramen.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I was eyeing that one, too. 
If I eat half, that basically makes it a 
half-bowl for you anyway.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: —You plan on eating more?!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Good grief, what am I to do with you...? 
Excuse me, sir—one karaage ramen, please.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Mm, you make a fair point... 
I suppose once in a while wouldn't hurt.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Both the broth and the chashu are 
exquisite. 
...It is delicious.

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Oho, that's what I call an appetite! I 
like it! 
Fried rice on the house for you and your 
friends!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Your spirit has reached me. 
Bring forth as much as you have—come.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Sigh... If it has come to this, I have no 
choice but to see it through. 
Steel yourself as well.
